actual: 200 image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8 issues=<script>;on*-attribute;javascript: in attribute nosniff=- csp=-

group: K. Engines, external languages, body limit
title: server process survives an upstream that stalls mid-body
actual: server process exited (code null): unhandled TimeoutError from answer.text()
note: In render-api.js the call is `return external(...)` inside try without await, so the rejection is not caught by the catch, and server.js does not catch the promise of handleApi: Node terminates on the unhandled rejection

group: K. Engines, external languages, body limit
title: upstream sends headers but never finishes the body
request: mock sends part of the body and stalls
expect: 504/502 within about 10 s (timeout covers the body)
note: AbortSignal.timeout also aborts answer.text() in modern Node, so the request is cut

group: K. Engines, external languages, body limit
title: upstream returns 100 MB of SVG
expect: refused (502/413) - memory of the server must be bounded
note: answer.text() buffers the whole upstream body; there is no size limit on what is relayed to the client
